post: Booking site for our yoga studio. We run 3 classes a day and right now everything lives in a Google Sheet plus DMs. Looking for someone to build: a public class schedule, member sign up / login, class packs paid through Stripe, and an admin view so the front desk can see who is coming. We have a logo and brand colors, no designs beyond that. Fixed price budget $2,500 - $3,500. Would like it live in about 6 weeks. Remote is totally fine, we're in Ohio and I'm on Zoom most days.

gold.why: Standard login, booking and Stripe build; $2,500-3,500 is roughly 100+ hours at the floor rate and the lead is cheap.

post: Hi, I own a small taco restaurant and need a new online ordering setup. I want a simple website with the menu and online ordering, and the POS tablets and printers in the kitchen all hooked up to it. Whoever takes this has to come to the restaurant (Portland, SE side) on a weekday morning to set up the tablets, run the cables for the receipt printer and test with my staff. I can pay $1,800 total. The website part is pretty basic honestly, the install is what I'm worried about.

gold.why: Budget would be fine but the job requires physically installing hardware at the restaurant, which is a hard no.

post: Looking for an ongoing web developer to maintain and extend our members portal (React + Node). Roughly 10 hours a week, long term. Budget is $400-$600 per month, paid monthly. Must be responsive on Slack during US hours. Great for someone who wants steady work with a friendly team!

gold.why: About 43 hours a month for $400-600 is roughly $9-14/hour, far below the $25 floor despite being steady work.

post:
Telegram bot for warehouse stock alerts

- Reads inventory from a Postgres DB (read-only access provided)
- Posts an alert to a Telegram group when a SKU drops under its threshold
- Admin commands: /threshold and /mute
- Small web page with login to view the bot logs

Hourly $30-45, estimated 40-60 hours. Weekly check-in on Zoom. We can start next week.

gold.why: Hourly rate is above the floor, the scope is a clear bot plus small login page, and 40-60 hours is a solid contract for a $2.40 lead.

post: We need a web app built for our company. It should have users and some kind of dashboard, plus maybe integrations later. Budget is flexible, depends on what you propose. Looking for someone who can think through the product with us. Please include examples of similar work and your estimate. No fixed timeline yet.

gold.why: No budget, no timeline and a very vague scope; nothing here says it can pay at the floor rate.

post: Small business site, about 5 pages (home, services, about, gallery, contact) plus a blog i can edit myself. I'm a landscaper in Ohio. Budget $600 to $800. I have the photos and all the text ready. Would like it done in 2 weeks. Quote on hosting too pls.

gold.why: The budget barely clears the $550 minimum and is borderline for a CMS blog, and a $38 lead is a large share of it.

post: We're building a subscription marketplace for local tutors. Total budget $6,000 for the MVP (web app with login, tutor profiles, booking, Stripe). Payment structure: 10% when we sign, and the remaining 90% is paid out of platform revenue as soon as we reach $10k in monthly sales. We have investors lined up so this should go quick. Looking to start asap.

gold.why: 90% of the fee is contingent on the platform reaching revenue, so it is pay-on-success, plus a $55 lead.

post: Price monitoring dashboard. A friend of mine is a registered dealer with several of our competitors, so I have 6 dealer logins. I need a script that logs into each dealer portal every night, pulls the wholesale price tables, and puts them in a searchable dashboard. They don't have an API. Budget $1,200 fixed. Rotating IPs would be a plus because they have started blocking us.

gold.why: Scraping competitor portals behind borrowed logins and dodging IP blocks is a terms-of-service violation, whatever the budget.

post: Hiring a developer for our scheduling web app (React + Django). Full project budget is $4,500. To pick the right person we ask the final 3 candidates to complete a short test: rebuild the weekly calendar view from our Figma file with drag and drop. It's about 4-6 hours of work. The test is unpaid, the selected candidate gets the contract and the others get a thank you.

gold.why: Good budget, but the 4-6 hour unpaid test before hire exceeds the one-hour limit for free work.

post: Internal admin dashboard for our logistics team (about 25 users). Needs login with roles, a table of shipmnets with filters, CSV import/export, and a few charts. The backend is a REST API that already exists, docs provided. Budget $2,800-$3,200. We're a small company in Berlin; calls would be on Zoom, usually 3-4pm CET. If you're ever in Berlin come say hi, but obviously not required.

gold.why: Admin dashboard with an existing API is squarely in stack; the in-person meet-up is optional so it is not onsite, and the budget covers it with room.

post: Need a LINE bot for my hair salon so customers can book and cancel appointments. My customers are mostly Taiwanese and Japanese so LINE is what they use. I'd rather talk on the phone first, you can tell me how it works and what it costs. I don't know how much this usually is. I have about 40 regular customers but want to grow. Thanks!

gold.why: LINE booking bot is in stack but there is no budget and the client has no idea of price, so it is only worth a cheap check on rate first.

post: 我們是台中的牙醫診所，想做線上預約系統。需求：病患用手機網頁預約（選醫師、選時段）、診所後台可以排班和看預約名單、預約前一天用 LINE 推播提醒。目前都是紙本跟 Excel。預算 8 萬到 12 萬，希望兩個月內上線。可以遠端，每週視訊討論進度就好。有做過類似系統的優先。

gold.why: 預約系統加 LINE 提醒正好是他的專長，預算 8-12 萬遠高於底線，可遠端，線索費很小。

post: 想做公司形象網站，大概六七頁（首頁、關於我們、產品、案例、最新消息、聯絡），最新消息和案例要可以自己登入後台新增。LOGO 跟文案都有了。預算 3~4 萬，請附上報價和類似作品。之前找過兩家都說做不完，這次希望找認真的人。

gold.why: 六七頁加簡易後台約 40 到 50 小時，3-4 萬高於底線並有餘裕；先前外包跑掉只是背景，不是硬性排除。

post:
公司內部請假與加班申請系統

- 員工約 60 人
- 員工登入後送出申請，主管線上簽核
- 簽核結果用 LINE 通知本人
- 人資可匯出月報表（Excel）

預算 NT$45,000-60,000，工期 6 週。全程遠端、視訊會議即可。

gold.why: 登入、簽核流程和 LINE 通知都是他做的類型，預算約 56-75 小時的量，足夠且全程遠端。

post: 想做一個社區版的蝦皮，讓社區住戶可以買賣二手物品，要有聊聊、評價、第三方支付、物流追蹤，之後還想做 App。預算面議，看你們怎麼報價。有想法的先私訊我，我再說明細節。

gold.why: 沒給預算、範圍像蝦皮縮小版又很模糊，但線索費是 0，只值得先回一句問預算與第一階段範圍。

post: 高雄民宿官網加線上訂房。需求：房型介紹、日曆即時顯示空房、線上付款、後台管理訂單。預算 7 萬。另外因為要串房門的智慧電子鎖，需要工程師每週到民宿現場測試跟安裝設備，大概要去 4 次。民宿在墾丁。

gold.why: 預算夠，但要親自到墾丁現場安裝與測試門鎖設備，屬於必須到場的硬性排除。
